hypothesis: The routed-v6 policy was trained and routed as procedural_v1, while the strongest reply-search comparison used procedural_v2. Rotating starting assignments on odd seeds may account for part of the observed model-search gap.
arena: Classic Generic 11x9 two-player, action limit1000, routed-v6 direct versus native reply-search root256/slate8/opponent64

comparison.control: Even seeds should have the same generated scenario in both schemas; verify identical per-map outcomes. Odd seeds rotate the player assignment. Compare model win counts and map-grouped model-versus-search outcomes separately for even and odd seeds.

interpretation: This is an exploratory domain-shift localization, not a student training or promotion gate. A changed model-search gap on odd seeds would suggest sensitivity to starting assignment; equal results would weaken that explanation. No student will be rated or deployed from this audit.
